From: Ethan Lowe <ethan@paragonsys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22 09:18 AM -0400
Subject: Quickstart docs: Request for technical demo

Hi Mina,

I hit the "Request technical demo" link on the Quickstart docs and it routed me here — thanks for being available. We’re Paragon Systems (platform infra team). We’ve started a small pilot integrating an LLM for code-assist and routing requests through our microservice layer. Before we commit to a longer eval we want a focused technical demo to cover:

- integration patterns for token streaming and prefix caching
- expected latency under 100 qps (our target) and concurrency behaviors
- privacy controls / data retention options for hosted vs private deployments

Ideal timing: week of July 27, mornings PST work best for our engineers.

Quick notes about our stack: Node.js edge service, gRPC to internal microservices, and we’ll likely use a small proprietary test dataset (not production). Happy to share a sample payload if that helps.

Thanks,
Ethan Lowe
Platform Lead, Paragon Systems
ethan@paragonsys.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22 10:05 AM -0400
Subject: Re: Quickstart docs: Request for technical demo

Thanks Ethan — I’m Mina on the SDR/solutions side, I routed your request to our engineering team and can help get a slot on the calendar. A couple quick clarifying Qs so Camila can tailor the session:

1) What level of concurrency do you expect during the demo (single-team load test vs production-like multi-client test)?
2) Which model families are you most interested in evaluating (high-quality base vs quantized low-latency)?

I can offer these times (all converted below to PST):
- Tue Jul 27 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Jul 28 08:30–09:15 PT
- Thu Jul 29 10:00–10:45 PT

Or you can pick a time directly on my calendar: https://calendly.com/mina-haddad/30min

Notes / logistics: Camila (engineering) will bring a short agenda and a checklist for pre-demo items (sample payload, allowlist IPs, and test S3 link). We’ll attach the agenda once the engineer confirms. If Aug 3 works better we can push — just tell me preferred windows.

If you can share a single small payload or a link to a sample (S3/presigned or Drive) that’d speed things up.

Best,
Mina Haddad
SDR, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Mina — appreciate the quick reply.

Short answers:
- Concurrency: for the demo we’ll simulate ~50 concurrent sessions (not full production), but we care about headroom to 100 qps.
- Model family: we want a balance — primary interest in a quantized low-latency variant but would like to compare to a higher-accuracy baseline.

Unfortunately the July 27–29 windows are a little tight for our engineers. Could we look at Mon Aug 3 or Tue Aug 4 in the morning PST? Preferably 09:00–11:00 PT.

I’ll upload a small sample payload to a presigned S3 link by EOD Friday and share the link to this thread. The sample will be sanitized.

Thanks — Ethan
